verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document Claude Code accepting a sketch, image, or PDF and generating a working app from it. The closest items are an MCP example prompt about updating an email template from Figma designs and a claim about reading design docs in Google Drive via MCP. Both rely on third-party MCP connections, are adjacent features, and are not a documented image/sketch/PDF-to-app capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can generate a working app from a sketch, image, or PDF design
